name: peptalk
description: Gestalt language translation tool using Peppa Pig clips

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8111
scripts.ingest: cd backend && uv run python scripts/ingest.py
scripts.deploy: cd frontend && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.peppatalk.com NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDIA_URL=https://media.peppatalk.com npm run build && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name peptalk --branch main
